messages:
Aisha: Hey team — quick one. I'm primary for the EU night block (00:00-08:00 UTC) this Fri-Sun but had a family emergency and need someone to take the Friday night primary (00:00-08:00 UTC). Secondary is currently unassigned for that slot. I know this is short notice, sorry.

Aisha: There's an active SEV2 on generator-workers (OOMs) and the incident bridge is up: https://redwood.incidents/BR-1223 — customer impact: degraded completions for a few EU tenants (higher latencies / partial failures). Runbook: https://kb.redwood/runbooks/generator-oom (TL;DR: restart worker group, bump mem, check warm cache).

Aisha: If you can take primary, reply "taking" here and I'll start the rotation transfer and share the minimal access steps. If you can only shadow for a few hours, say so. Need someone to be the person answering pages & running the runbook for the first 4–6 hours.

Carlos: taking. I can own Fri night primary. I can be on the bridge from 23:50 UTC and cover until at least 04:00 UTC, then we can hand to Priya or Miguel. :thumbsup:

Priya: I can be secondary / shadow until 03:00 UTC, then Miguel can pick up if needed. Not great for late-night push approvals but can do triage + runbook steps.

oncall-bot: Incident BR-1223 — SEV2: generator-workers OOM. Bridge started by auto-pager at 2026-03-14T22:12Z. Pager count: 3 (EU infra). Link: https://redwood.incidents/BR-1223

Aisha: Thanks Carlos. I'm kicking the oncall transfer now — please run /oncall accept when you see the pending transfer. Quick runbook highlights below so you don't have to open the whole doc: 

```
Check metrics: /metrics/generator/error-rate and /metrics/k8s/oom_count
If OOM spikes >3 / 5m: kubectl scale deploy/generator-workers --replicas=0 -n inference && sleep 10 && kubectl scale deploy/generator-workers --replicas=3 -n inference
If restarts show repeated OOMs: increase memory request in generator-workers deployment (patch+rollout)
If completions queue backlog > 5000: enable prefix cache flush: /admin/cache/flush generator-prefix
Always annotate incident with tenant IDs and drop-in csv to channel
```

Aisha: Note: customer-facing ticketing already opened by support; SRE lead asked to avoid rolling restart unless we've confirmed memory bump won't hit prod spike window (we're in a quiet interval for EU but still watch).

Carlos: I see the pending transfer in the oncall console. Running `/oncall accept` now. Also creating a quick canary on staging with 2x memory to validate config before prod patch. Will update bridge in 5.

deploy-bot: Oncall transfer requested: from Aisha -> Carlos. Pending acceptance.

Carlos: /oncall accept — accepted. I'm primary for Fri 00:00-08:00 UTC. I've joined the bridge (https://redwood.incidents/BR-1223/bridge). First checks: error-rate spike is concentrated in eu-west-1, generator-workers pod 3 shows repeated OOMs and crashloop backoff. Will attempt controlled restart on pod set A.

Miguel: I can be backup from 03:30 UTC onward if anything slips past 04:00. Will keep my phone on.

Priya: I'll handover to Miguel at 03:00 UTC if Carlos still needs me to step out. Otherwise I'll stay as secondary until 06:00 if required.

Carlos: Restarted pod set A per runbook; crashloop appears to stabilize. Watching error-rate and queue. If it comes back we'll increase mem request and rollout a patch. Noticing a second tier of failures tied to a config that reduces JVM heap — looking into a safe bump.

Aisha: huge thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick cover. Logging this handoff in ops-journal: "Aisha -> Carlos (primary), Priya (secondary until 03:00), Miguel (backup from 03:30)." I put the minimal admin steps in the runbook block above.

Carlos: will post a quick post-incident note after the bridge ends with timeline + tenant list. For anyone taking over later: watch /metrics/k8s/oom_count and the completions backlog alert (alert id: infra.generator_high_backlog).

Priya: noted. If anyone needs direct keys for temporary access I can coordinate with security to grant short-lived creds (SSH/KMS) — prefer to use the console link in the runbook.

Aisha: closing the ask here — Carlos, confirm in the thread when you no longer need the swap and I'll revoke the transfer if it's unused for next rotation. Thanks again. :heart:
